name: Polar
symbol: Checkout embedding limited to allowed hosts
title: Polar: Checkout embedding limited to allowed hosts (behavior change)
summary: Organizations created from 4 August 2026 need a list before they can embed
replacement: Choose which hosts are allowed to embed your checkout, in Settings → Preferences → Embedding.

name: Polar
title: Polar: Webhook signing for new endpoints (new default)
summary: New webhook endpoints with secrets generated by Polar on or after September 8, 2026 at 00:00 UTC use signing compliant with the Standard Webhooks specification
replacement: To adopt Standard Webhooks signing for an existing endpoint, regenerate its secret and update your webhook handler to use the new secret. When using a Standard Webhooks library directly, pass the new secret as-is, without Base64-encoding it first.
